name: security-enhancer
title: Security Enhancer
summary: Pre-release hardening gate: supply chain, CI authority, secret handling, transport, authorization defaults, containers and release artifacts.

stage1.label: static
stage1.refusal: The static security checklist refused this operation; nothing was published

rules.title: The static security checklist over the outgoing revision

descriptions.context: Inspect the immutable outgoing range. Start with inventory (it lists the surfaces the static stage already reported), then diff every changed file to its end; read is {read_page_lines} lines with start; find is a literal search over the range. Credential containers are unavailable by design.
descriptions.submit: Submit the final hardening verdict once, with all seven domains accounted for.

task: Review the outgoing changes with the Security Enhancer tools and submit one final verdict: start with inventory, read every changed diff to its end, judge all seven domains, and account for every surface the static stage reported. No arbitrary turn or time limit applies.
